provenance.reason: The original _SYSTEM/state/ema200-freeze-2026-07-29.json was written in an ephemeral session container and never committed; it is unreachable from this branch. Numbers below are transcribed from the delivered PDFs, which are the only surviving record of the frozen forecast.
provenance.integrity: Entry/stop/target/probability/CRV/EV values are transcribed verbatim from the v3 table. No value was recomputed, re-derived, or adjusted during reconstruction. Where the PDFs do not state something, the field is marked reconstructed:true rather than filled in.
provenance.risk: Transcription from a PDF text layer can introduce digit errors. Any evaluation run should be treated as advisory until at least a sample of the entries is checked against the delivered PDF by the owner.

REVERSAL_CONFIRMED.definition: Close on the review date is above BOTH the 2026-07-29 close AND the then-current EMA200 on that same date.
REVERSAL_CONFIRMED.note: Deliberately strict. A title sitting sideways above the level does not count — a reversal requires an upward move.

ENTRY_TRIGGER_V2.source: antwort.pdf (rule v2 changelog, fixed before outcome data existed)
ENTRY_TRIGGER_V2.definition: A daily bar in the review window must contain the entry level inside its [low, high] range before stop and target logic applies.
ENTRY_TRIGGER_V2.notTriggered: If no bar contains the entry, the setup is NOT_TRIGGERED and carries no R. A setup that is never reached cannot be a winner.
ENTRY_TRIGGER_V2.defect: Rule v1 lacked this check. Back-dated onto a real 5-day window it reported 16 winners of 23, including COHR with a target 47% above the traded price and WDC 'winning' 26% above its own entry.

TRADE_OUTCOME.reconstructionNote: antwort.pdf states three measures but only spells out REVERSAL_CONFIRMED verbatim. This definition is this session's reconstruction of the second measure, written before outcome data exists, and is flagged as such rather than presented as the original wording.
TRADE_OUTCOME.definition: On triggered setups only: R-multiple from entry, stop and target. Bar-level first-touch precedence; when a single bar touches both stop and target, the stop counts (conservative, no intrabar path assumption).
TRADE_OUTCOME.open: A setup still open at the review date is marked OPEN and scored at mark-to-market R, reported separately from closed R.

CALIBRATION.reconstructionNote: Third measure, reconstructed on the same basis as TRADE_OUTCOME.
CALIBRATION.definition: Brier score of the stated P(reversal) against the binary REVERSAL_CONFIRMED outcome, plus Spearman rank correlation between predicted rank and realized outcome rank.

reviewDates.caveat: Seven days tests a narrower claim than the model makes. The report states a horizon of roughly four weeks. A bad 7-day result does not refute the model; a good one does not confirm it.
Approximately the four-week horizon the model actually claims. NVDA reports on this date after the close, so its 2026-08-26 close is still pre-report.

statisticalLimits.correlation: 23 strongly correlated titles in one macro regime — the effective independent sample is closer to 3 to 5. This is weak evidence in both directions.
statisticalLimits.earningsCohort: Titles reporting inside the window have their outcome tested by the event, not by the EMA200 signal. The evaluator separates this cohort.
statisticalLimits.thinBaseRates: Hit rates with n below 10 are thin evidence. SNDK has n=0 (2025 spin-off) — its 46% is a coin, not a measurement.

modelNotes.regimeDiscountNote: Raised from -6 in v2 because the FOMC outcome was more hawkish than priced (9:3 hold with three dissents for a HIKE).
modelNotes.candleNote: 13 of 23 titles printed a Marubozu down candle with the close on the day's low on 2026-07-29 — continuation, not exhaustion. Only CHRW (bullish engulfing) and DVN (neutral candle, bullish RSI divergence at 0.55x volume) printed the opposite.
modelNotes.txtNote: TXT is presumed a typo for TXN in an otherwise pure semiconductor list. Both were computed and both are included.
